scope: Seventeenth additive botanical identity shard. Conservative R4 binding for the Adelaide Durif row using current GrapeGen registered-name evidence.

grapegen06-durif-3738-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - European Grapevine Catalogue, Annex 1A
grapegen06-durif-3738-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen identifies DURIF, VIVC 3738, and the French registered proposition Durif N. UC Davis FPS independently lists Durif as the variety name and Petite Sirah/Petite Syrah as synonyms. Adelaide omits the registered color code, so the source proposition is conservatively R4.
